stories.title: llm-gemini 0.36
stories.author: Simon Willison
stories.snippet: Release: llm-gemini 0.36 Gemini 4 Carbon was announced two weeks ago for "a subset of cyber defenders", but today it's available to everyone else . This is Google's best ever Gemini, priced at $2/million input and $10/million output at launch (that's GPT-6.1 Sol / Claude Sonnet 5.5 prices) but scheduled to double in price to $4/$20 on December 1st (same as Opus 5.5). Here are three pelicans for the low, medium and high thinking efforts (it defaults to medium).
